summary: Beamr Imaging Ltd., a Nasdaq-listed Israeli foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on September 16, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the launch of ML-Safe lossless compression for autonomous vehicle fleets. No transaction, securities offering, or corporate action is involved; the filing is a routine product announcement. The release details a product demo at AutoSens Europe in Barcelona on September 22–24, 2026, at stand 131, and cites 47% file-size reduction on 12-bit Bayer recordings from 8-megapixel cameras. No deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations appear; the risk-arb angle is immaterial.
